available_loader.behavior: downloads and verifies the complete official archive before safe extraction

preferred_acquisition.download_bytes: approximately 6.3 GB; exact server length must be recorded before acquisition
preferred_acquisition.policy: The official gzip tar is not a random-access one-hour dataset. Do not claim that saving only selected extracted clips eliminates full archive transfer. Acquisition has not started.
preferred_acquisition.receipt: Record resolved URL, byte count, published MD5 verification, archive SHA256, extraction tool/version, and license/metadata hashes. Keep all acquired files and receipts inside improvement/r3_data.

lower_transfer_options.option: Existing local or institution-hosted verified official archive
lower_transfer_options.requirements: If available, independently verify the published MD5, record original source and archive SHA256, then reuse without downloading. No such copy has been established.

lower_transfer_options.option: Pinned per-utterance mirror or streaming dataset
lower_transfer_options.requirements: First establish immutable revision, complete train-clean-100 metadata inventory, CC-BY-4.0 provenance, exact official utterance mapping, speaker/source IDs, decoded-audio hashes, and round-trip transcript agreement. Preselect IDs from metadata without ASR/attack/quality outcomes before fetching audio. Record total transferred bytes including skipped stream/shard data. This is conditional and unverified, not a silently interchangeable dataset.

selection_preregistration.selection_inputs: Complete official metadata/audio inventory plus frozen source-development, inherited history, confirmation, and final-reserve inventories; no attack, ASR or quality outcomes
selection_preregistration.audio_policy: Native mono 16 kHz, finite samples in [-1,1], original full transcript. No transcript-unaligned crops, resampling, normalization, or outcome-based exclusion.
selection_preregistration.speaker_balance: Sort eligible speakers by SHA256('r3-train-seed11|' + speaker). Within each speaker sort eligible utterances by ascending duration, then SHA256('r3-train-seed11|' + utterance_id). Emit one utterance per speaker per round until exhausted. This freezes a duration-first speaker-balanced stream without performance outcomes.
selection_preregistration.nested_sizes: Select the smallest prefix reaching at least 3600 seconds for the one-hour subset, and the smallest prefix reaching at least 36000 seconds for the ten-hour subset. Permit at most one original-utterance overshoot of <=30 seconds; record exact durations. One-hour IDs must be a subset of ten-hour IDs. Do not crop to an exact hour.
exclusions_before_selection: Reject speakers and source-recording identities occurring in any known development, confirmation, or final pool.
Reject matching corpus/utterance IDs and exact audio file hashes.
Reject exact normalized transcript duplicates after Unicode NFKC, case folding, punctuation removal and whitespace normalization; inspect source chapters/books for repeated passages.
Run a declared near-duplicate/resampled/cropped-audio similarity audit and source/speaker identity review; exact hashes alone are insufficient.
Verify duration/language/sample-rate metadata from decoded audio; archive every exclusion reason before training.
freeze_outputs: one-hour and ten-hour JSONL manifests with original transcript, speaker/chapter/book/source identities, decoded samples/duration, file and canonical decoded-audio hashes
metadata inventory SHA256, speaker order, selection code SHA256, selection seed, exclusions and duplicate-audit report
corpus/source version, archive receipts, license, metadata hashes, overlap/pretraining disclosure
per-speaker duration/count distributions and nested-subset verification
selection_preregistration.future_final_reserve: Any later acquired final reserve must exclude training speakers/source identities and audio/text duplicates. If adequate provenance cannot be verified, results remain development-only.

implementation_registration.lean_test: One seed, at most one measured GPU-hour of training after manifest and calibration freeze; feasibility only.
implementation_registration.full_seed_budget: At most 12000 optimizer updates or 8 measured GPU-hours, whichever occurs first; source checkpoint selection every500 optimizer updates.
implementation_registration.memory: Model parameters are about6.36 MB in float32; generator parameters+gradients+two AdamW moments about25.45 MB, excluding all activations, source Whisper-small, frozen WavLM, CUDA context and workspaces. Full GPU fit is unmeasured. Sequential backward recomputation separates source/content activation graphs; batch1 accumulation4.
